Maya T: Heads-up — we need a concise benchmark narrative for the launch blog + webinar. working title: 'Tail-risk economics for product SLAs'. want a clear 2-up visual and a single customer vignette.
Owen L: I like the framing. Product folks care about the slow requests and the bill. suggest we call out p50/p95/p999 with a short takeaway line under each. :mag_right:
Pri Patel: Visual idea: left = CDF (percent requests vs latency) for three serving configs; right = compact $/1k tokens with annotations for quantization, batching, and caching. Keep language non-technical.
Maya T: Can you paste a tiny bench sample we can use to mock the chart?
Owen L: Paste from the mixed-chat slice (anonymized):
```
config,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,p999_ms,usd_per_1k
prod-fast-q8,52,160,310,560,0.34
prod-balanced-fp16,70,210,420,900,0.49
prod-cheap-quant,130,360,620,1400,0.16
```
Pri Patel: Perfect. For copy: lead with the problem in one line: "Averages mask the slow requests that hurt UX and increase spend." Then solution: "Routing + quantization + cache reduce tail risk and lower unit economics."
Maya T: Want one concrete vignette: short format: "Customer Y: 99.9th from ~1.4s to ~560ms; token cost down ~22% (rounded)." That gives credibility.
Owen L: Agree — anonymize and round. Also add a tiny box that explains tradeoffs: "Lower cost = slightly higher median for non-interactive workloads." Keep it clear.
Pri Patel: Designer notes: CDF x-axis linear to 2000ms; add vertical markers at p50/p95/p999. Color palette: sea (fast), ochre (balanced), slate (cheap). Right panel: bars with small callouts (+/- variability).
DesignBot: Noted — will mock a two-slide hero with those constraints and deliver an SVG.
Maya T: CTA for post: "Register for the benchmark deep-dive + live Q&A." We'll link the webinar registration. EngOpsBot: please auto-post registration link.
EngOpsBot: registration -> https://redwood.ai/webinar-tail-risk (auto-posted) :calendar:
Owen L: Ops note: we'll pin the bench commit and dataset id in the post notes for reproducibility. commit = c7d9a2f. dataset = chat-mix-2026-q1. I'll attach CSV in the ops channel.
Pri Patel: Headline options (short): 1) "Measure the tail, manage the cost" 2) "Benchmarks that map to your SLA" 3) "Tail-risk economics for product teams" Which should we use?
Maya T: Lean #3 but tighter: "Tail-risk economics for product teams" (use as subhead under hero).
Owen L: For the blog intro paragraph: 2 sentences. 1) Problem: "means hide slow requests that matter to users." 2) Solution: "Redwood's serving stacks, routing, and model profiles shrink the tail and reduce spend." Then point to visuals and CTA.
Pri Patel: I'll draft the social copy variants (short, medium, long) and the webinar blurb.
Maya T: Action items: Pri to draft social + blurb by EOD; Design to produce hero mock by tomorrow noon; Owen to post CSV+SHA in ops and confirm numbers; Maya to finalize launch schedule and publish plan. Any objections?
All: none. Maya: thanks — will queue the launch slot.
DesignBot: mock scheduled for 12:00 UTC tomorrow.
EngOpsBot: tracking link created -> https://redwood.ai/track/tail-risk-webinar (auto) :white_check_mark:
